FN-W1BWI59-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 66
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Ontario Tillman
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 12/16/2025
House Bill 66 as introduced could increase the obligations of Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA) by an undetermined amount to provide for the voluntarily designation of
certain medical conditions on an individual's driver license or identification card.
